issue: Excess transparent padding inside character sprite bounding boxes / SVG viewBoxes
consequences: Detached contact shadows (shadow renders below transparent margin, making critter float above the rug)
Feet sliding/floating during squash-and-stretch (pivot point is at canvas bottom rather than feet baseline)
Oversized/phantom tap hitboxes (clicks register on empty air around the pet)
Inconsistent visual scale across the 9 pet variants (variants with more padding appear disproportionately smaller)

council_solution.step_1_tight_crop: Trim raster/vector canvases to tight visual bounds (union of all animation frames in viewBox to avoid frame jitter).
council_solution.step_2_pivot_alignment: Set contact baseline at local y = 0. In Sprite2D/AnimatedSprite2D: centered = false, offset = Vector2(-W * 0.5, -H) to ensure visual pivot is (0.5, 1.0).
council_solution.step_3_hitbox_refit: Rebuild CollisionShape2D or Control hitboxes tightly against the visible W x H dimensions.
council_solution.step_4_shadow_anchor: Anchor the soft fern-caramel contact shadow directly to the (0, 0) feet origin.
